---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What problem does this solve?**
A clear description of the use case this feature addresses.

**Proposed solution**
What you'd like to see happen. If it touches scenario/environment/
variables file formats, sketch the JSON shape you have in mind.

**Alternatives considered**
Any alternative approaches you considered.

**Constitution / roadmap alignment**
Does this align with an existing roadmap item in `docs/ROADMAP.md`, or is
it a new direction? Does it keep scenarios 100% declarative (no code
required per test case, per the project's constitution)?
